card.name: Small words in Darwin-style species passages
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'of' and 'new' in old natural-history prose about species, varieties and their spread. Also a few scattered words like 'stood' or 'live' before a following word.

modes.label: Species and varieties prose
modes.description: 'of' or 'new' right before 'spreading', 'new varieties' or 'life' in evolution-era writing.
modes.example: give birth to the greatest number<< of>> new varieties or incipient species.

modes.label: Scattered other words
modes.description: A verb or adjective in a fixed phrase, such as 'stands' after thermometer or 'live' before 'or attenuated vaccines'.
